title: OpenFIQA Studio — typed scientific objects
description: Source of truth for the scientific type system. TypeScript and Python types are generated from this file; neither side may define these shapes independently. P01 disproved the peer-engine model, so this schema deliberately makes the disproved shapes unrepresentable: there is no bare quality score, and a feature table is not a quality vector.

EngineRef.description: Which implementation produced a value. Version strings alone are not a sufficient provenance key — ofiqpy reports 0.1.1 in pyproject and 0.1.0 at runtime (B-P01-05) — so commit is required whenever it is knowable.

ScoreSemantics.description: A score is meaningless without its definition. This block is required on every score-bearing object, which is what prevents three different unified scores from sharing a column.

definition_id.description: Stable identifier for what the number means, e.g. ofiqpy.UnifiedQualityScore, openfiqa.profile_score, ofiq_quality.predicted_score. Never reuse an id across engines.

direction.description: unknown is a legitimate persisted value. P01 could not verify direction for any engine; recording unknown is required, guessing is not.

EngineScore.description: The ONLY way a score may be represented. There is deliberately no plain number form — a bare float cannot carry which engine produced it or what it means, and admitting one is how cross-engine conflation happens silently.

ScientificState.description: These are ordered but NOT automatically promoted. A value may only advance when the evidence for that specific transition exists. Any US-FIQA score computed through the defective polarity map (B-P01-03) is capped at COMPUTED.

QualityComponent.description: One ISO-style component. ofiqpy returns (raw, scalar) per component; raw polarity varies per component and is mis-declared upstream for 10 of 27 (B-P01-03), which is why raw and scalar are separate fields and raw carries its own polarity.

polarity_map_revision.description: Which revision of the polarity map produced raw_polarity. Required for audit while B-P01-03 is open.

QualityVector.description: The complete component output of ONE extractor on ONE sample. Not comparable element-wise across engines without an explicit comparison method.

unified.description: Present only when the engine itself emits one. Never synthesised by the studio.

raw_output.description: Path to the preserved unparsed engine output.

FeatureTable.description: A distinct type from QualityVector, forced by P01/C3. ofiq-quality consumes 47 columns of which only 27 are extractor output; the other 20 come from a feature-engineering stage that no published distribution exposes (B-P01-01). Modelling this as a QualityVector would hide that gap.

contract_digest.description: sha256 of the column contract. The known US-FIQA contract is 3b6ec824ab4768410bcb98b9d7f14e391abb25fd0d85f619dfafacbd89872410.

produced_by.description: Null is legitimate and currently correct: no packaged producer exists (B-P01-01).

ImageSample.description: Bytes stay on disk and are referenced, never inlined into metadata. classification is required so a restricted sample cannot reach a public export by omission.

authorization.description: What permits this sample's use. Required to be non-null for anything but PUBLIC before P05 may import it.

TransformRecord.description: P05's gate requires interactive preview and batch execution to call the same implementation and agree for deterministic settings. Recording implementation plus both hashes is what makes that checkable rather than asserted.

CrossEngineComparison.description: Cross-engine comparison must name its method. There is no default, because the default people reach for — compare the raw numbers — is the invalid one.

asserts_numeric_equivalence.description: Pinned false. No comparison may claim engine scores are numerically equivalent.
